desenho: RCT (experimento em survey com 4 braços de prognóstico; medida antes-depois intra-sujeito, sem braço sem prognóstico)
outcome: opted not to vote for their preferred candidate after being exposed to an election forecast (troca “yes to no”)
modelo: Seção 5 Results (p. 24 impressa; folha 25 do PDF), texto: taxa de troca entre quem havia decidido votar antes do prognóstico

evidencia: For those that decided to vote for their preferred candidate initially (n = 163), 13% opted not to vote for them after being exposed to an election forecast.

desenho: RCT (experimento em survey com 4 braços de prognóstico; medida antes-depois intra-sujeito, sem braço sem prognóstico)
outcome: changed their decision to vote after being exposed to an election forecast (troca “no to yes”)

evidencia: For those that decided against voting for their preferred candidate initially (n = 23), 26% changed their decision to vote after being exposed to an election forecast.
